name: Las Navas del Marqués (Spain)
description: Green field with a white cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Las Navas del Marqués (thirteen roundels on blue).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially by decree of 15 December 1993 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 16 of 21 April 1994).

features.role: Las Navas del Marqués arms — thirteen roundels on blue
